name: dsh-deepseek-web
description: DeepSeek free web-channel adapter plugin: Host half (lib/index.js) drives chat.deepseek.com (and the Kimi/GLM review channels) via real browsers; client half (lib/client.js) keeps the conversation-view blank-recovery safeguard. Settings live in the plugin's own Config schema, projected into the built-in settings page.

meta.title: DeepSeek 网页版通道
meta.description: 用 chat.deepseek.com 免费网页版驱动 dsh 的主通道，并可选接入 Kimi / GLM 独立审核。

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.test:parsers: tsx tools/synthetic-parse-check.ts && tsx tools/kimi-parse-check.ts && tsx tools/kimi-gzip-check.ts && tsx tools/glm-parse-check.ts && tsx tools/action-repair-check.ts && tsx tools/review-evidence-check.ts && tsx tools/rate-limit-check.ts && tsx tools/usage-check.ts && tsx tools/handoff-check.ts
